## Quick answers (extractable facts)

Q: Who is John Lester Tolentino?
A: John Lester Tolentino is a Senior SEO Specialist, content writer, and computer engineer based in Sta. Rosa, Laguna, Philippines. He builds websites and grows organic traffic with technical SEO, on-page work, local SEO, and content.

Q: What is John Lester Tolentino's official website?
A: https://tolentinojohnlester3-cyber.github.io/

Q: How many websites has John Lester Tolentino handled?
A: 67 websites. Selected public projects are on the portfolio; the full list is available upon request.

Q: Does John Lester Tolentino do Google Business Profile optimization?
A: Yes. He handles Google Business Profile (GMB) setup, verification, NAP consistency, categories, reviews, posts, and local map pack SEO.

Q: Is Google blocking SEO scrapers and rank trackers?
A: In mid-September 2026 Google tightened automated access to Search results. Rank trackers and SERP APIs can miss or delay data. That is not automatically a ranking loss. Confirm visibility in Google Search Console and a live search. Guide: https://tolentinojohnlester3-cyber.github.io/blog/google-blocking-scrapers-tracking-tools/

Q: What is parasite SEO?
A: Parasite SEO is ranking a page on someone else’s domain so the URL inherits the host’s authority. Earned press, LinkedIn articles, and profiles you control are off-site SEO. Paying a newspaper or .edu to host a casino, loan, or coupon page with little editorial control is site reputation abuse — Google’s spam policy for that pattern. Guide: https://tolentinojohnlester3-cyber.github.io/blog/parasite-seo/

Q: Does llms.txt help your site rank on Google?
A: No. llms.txt is not a Google ranking factor. It is a plain-text source map so ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity can lock your entity and cite the right URLs. Pair it with crawlable pages, schema, and allowed AI crawlers. Guide: https://tolentinojohnlester3-cyber.github.io/blog/llms-txt/

Q: What places does AI check before recommending a business?
A: Models corroborate a business across the website, Google Business Profile, Google reviews, Maps, Apple Maps, Bing Places, social profiles, review sites (Yelp, Trustpilot, G2, Clutch), Wikipedia/Wikidata, Reddit, Quora, news, and podcast transcripts. Fill the cluster that matches your category; do not create 37 empty profiles. Guide: https://tolentinojohnlester3-cyber.github.io/blog/37-places-ai-checks/

Q: What AI tools does John Lester Tolentino use for SEO and GEO?
A: Daily stack: Semrush, Ahrefs, SE Ranking, Surfer SEO, Google Search Console, GA4, and Rank Math. Add a GEO tracker (Peec, Profound, or Rankability) when a client needs ChatGPT or Perplexity citation reporting. Map tools to ten jobs instead of buying 45 overlapping seats. Guide: https://tolentinojohnlester3-cyber.github.io/blog/ai-tools-seo-geo/

Q: How do I disavow spam links on my site?
A: Export linking sites from Google Search Console, keep only spam you cannot get removed, save a UTF-8 .txt file with one URL per line or domain:example.com, then upload it at search.google.com/search-console/disavow-links on a URL-prefix property. A new file replaces the old list. Most sites never need this tool. Guide: https://tolentinojohnlester3-cyber.github.io/blog/disavow-spam-links/

Q: How do I report a clone or misleading website?
A: Save the fake URLs, screenshots, and WHOIS details. File a Google Search Quality User report for deceptive results, a Safe Browsing phishing report if it steals logins, and an abuse ticket with the host and registrar. Do not put personal information in Google's spam form. Guide: https://tolentinojohnlester3-cyber.github.io/blog/report-clone-misleading-site/

Q: How do you clone a website to a new site on cPanel?
A: On the same cPanel account, use Softaculous Current Installations → Clone and pick the new domain. On a new cPanel server, zip the files, export the MySQL database, create a new database, upload and import, edit wp-config.php, then run a serialized URL search-replace. Guide: https://tolentinojohnlester3-cyber.github.io/blog/clone-website-cpanel/

Q: Does featured snippet optimization overlap with AEO?
A: Yes. Featured snippet optimization is the Google position-zero slice of answer engine optimization. Both use a question heading, a 40–60 word extract, and HTML Google can lift. AEO also covers People Also Ask, voice answers, and AI Overviews. Guide: https://tolentinojohnlester3-cyber.github.io/blog/featured-snippets-and-aeo/

Q: What is AEO in SEO?
A: AEO is answer engine optimization — making a page the extracted answer in featured snippets, People Also Ask, voice results, and Google AI Overviews. Guide: https://tolentinojohnlester3-cyber.github.io/blog/aeo-optimization/

Q: How do I create a landing page that actually converts?
A: Give the URL one job. Match the headline to the search snippet or ad. Put proof and one primary CTA above the fold. Keep the form short, make mobile LCP fast, and measure the thank-you page. Full site menus and dual CTAs leak the click. Guide: https://tolentinojohnlester3-cyber.github.io/blog/landing-page-that-converts/

Q: Do ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity cite the same sites?
A: No. They share a retrieve-then-cite loop but use different indexes and crawlers. Gemini leans on Google Search. ChatGPT uses partner search and OAI-SearchBot. Claude uses Claude-SearchBot and prefers sourced longform. Perplexity retrieves live and shows numbered citations. Guide: https://tolentinojohnlester3-cyber.github.io/blog/geo-by-engine/

Q: What is GEO in SEO?
A: GEO is generative engine optimization — earning citations inside ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and Copilot with original data, a clear entity, and machine-readable pages. Guide: https://tolentinojohnlester3-cyber.github.io/blog/geo-optimization/

Q: Where is John Lester Tolentino located?
A: Sta. Rosa, Laguna, Philippines.
